dct_creator_sm: Government of Alberta, Environment and Protected Areas.
dct_description_sm: The Government of Alberta monitors, evaluates, and reports on the condition of lakes and reservoirs across Alberta, while also providing funding to external partners (e.g., the Alberta Lakes Management Society [ALMS]) for similar activities including operation of the ALMS LakeWatch program. The Government of Alberta has designed and implemented several lakes and reservoirs water quality and aquatic ecosystem health monitoring programs related to: 1. lakes and reservoirs of regional importance across the province (i.e., regional lakes program); and 2. targeted lakes for long-term and extensive monitoring (i.e., long term lakes network, sentinel lakes). These programs operated across three decades (i.e., regional lakes; 2005-2024; long-term lake network; 2003-2018), or continue to run currently (i.e., sentinel lakes; 2018-present). Lakes and reservoirs under these programs were monitored primarily monthly during open water conditions (~June – September) but may include some monitoring during winter conditions.
dct_title_s: Government of Alberta long-term lakes and reservoirs monitoring programs
